title: Stand By for Crime
paragraphs: A 1953 syndicated mystery series starring Glenn Langan as Los Angeles radio newsman Chuck Morgan, who follows crime tips beyond the newsroom and into active investigations.

Syndicated crime series built around Los Angeles radio newsman Chuck Morgan and secretary Carol Curtis. The frozen GRH set is the 26-program U.S. production from 1953. Contemporary and Australian/reference sources document a later expansion to 52 total programs, with the second 26 produced in Australia; those absent programs are represented only as series history, not manufactured as archive episodes.
GRH documents the program through 26-program U.S. production (1953 to 1953) and Australian continuation / expanded package (1954).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Adele Jergens (performer on 26 recordings), Glenn Langan (performer on 26 recordings), and Bob Reichenbach (producer on 24 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include radio news reporting and crime investigation, murder and suspicious death, espionage, subversion and Cold War intrigue, money, theft and insurance schemes, narcotics and organized crime, and kidnapping and coercion.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including 1953 U.S. syndicated crime production, Radio newscaster as amateur detective, Expansion from 26 to 52 episodes, and Australian-produced second half.
